- Top header band: product name 「D1 Desk」 in hard #222222 engineering sans / technical lettering — brand is the dominant first signal on the page.

- Primary CTA in blue ballpoint ink (#1d4ed8): exactly 「进入工作台」 — the clearest action after the Token field; blue-ink emphasis on hard graph paper, engineering tone not playful script.
- Permission tip in smaller #9ca3af / #222222 technical type near the CTA: Token needs D1、Workers、Workers KV、Email Routing / Email Sending permissions; optional text link 「去创建 Token」.

Style: engineering hard tone field notebook — crisp, disciplined, tool-like. Real product name D1 Desk. Chinese UI labels. No invented prices, dates, versions, or commercial claims.
